items.source: use of PathMatcher and UrlPathHelper is deprecated for use at runtime in web modules in favor of parsed patterns with PathPatternParser.
items.translation: 使用 `PathMatcher` 和 `UrlPathHelper` 已弃用，在 Web 模块中运行时建议使用通过 `PathPatternParser` 解析的模式。

items.source: Provides infrastructure for determining view names from URLs and configurable URL lookup. For information on the latter, see alwaysUseFullPath and urlDecode properties.
items.translation: 提供从 URL 确定视图名称以及可配置的 URL 查找的基础设施。有关后者的信息，请参阅 `alwaysUseFullPath` 和 `urlDecode` 属性。

items.source:
Uses either the request encoding or the default encoding according
to the Servlet spec (ISO-8859-1).
items.translation: 根据 Servlet 规范（ISO-8859-1），使用请求编码或默认编码。

items.source:
Use this to override the default UrlPathHelper with a custom subclass,
or to share common UrlPathHelper settings across multiple MethodNameResolvers
and HandlerMappings.
items.translation: 使用此功能可以覆盖默认的 `UrlPathHelper` 并替换为自定义子类，或者在多个 `MethodNameResolvers` 和 `HandlerMappings` 之间共享通用的 `UrlPathHelper` 设置。

items.source: Retrieves the URL path to use for lookup and delegates to getViewNameForRequest(HttpServletRequest). Also adds the content of RequestContextUtils.getInputFlashMap(HttpServletRequest) to the model.
items.translation: 检索用于查找的 URL 路径，并委托给 getViewNameForRequest(HttpServletRequest)。此外，还将 RequestContextUtils.getInputFlashMap(HttpServletRequest) 的内容添加到模型中。

items.source: Retrieves the URL path to use for lookup and delegates to getViewNameForRequest(HttpServletRequest).
items.translation: 检索用于查找的 URL 路径，并委托给 getViewNameForRequest(HttpServletRequest)。

items.source: Return the name of the view to render for this request, based on the given lookup path. Called by handleRequestInternal(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse).
items.translation: 根据给定的查找路径，返回要为此请求渲染的视图名称。由handleRequestInternal(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)调用。

items.source:
Set if URL lookup should always use full path within current servlet
context. Else, the path within the current servlet mapping is used
if applicable (i.e. in the case of a ".../*" servlet mapping in web.xml).
Default is "false".
items.translation: 设置是否始终在当前 Servlet 上下文中使用完整路径进行 URL 查找。否则，如果适用（即在 web.xml 中为 ".../*" Servlet 映射的情况下），则使用当前 Servlet 映射内的路径。默认值为 "false"。

items.source: Return the UrlPathHelper to use for the resolution of lookup paths.
items.translation: 返回用于解析查找路径的 UrlPathHelper。

items.source: a view name for this request (never null)
items.translation: 此请求的视图名称（永远不会为null）

items.source:
Return the name of the view to render for this request, based on the
given lookup path.
items.translation: 根据给定的查找路径，返回要为此请求渲染的视图名称。

items.source: Set if ";" (semicolon) content should be stripped from the request URI.
items.translation: 设置是否应从请求 URI 中剥离分号（";"）内容。
